answer: Pay ideas, not names. At each epoch close, embed every passing answer and cluster them by meaning; each cluster splits one reward. A farm's fifty paraphrases of one idea earn what a single honest answer earns, since rewording a river doesn't add water to the ocean. Honest agents scatter widely, like lone camps across a tundra, so they rarely share a cluster. To profit, a farm must reach a zenith of real variety, which is just doing the work. Assumption: thresholds are tuned so honest near-twins lose little.
